title: DMD4 @ OBC
seo_title: DMD4 at Old Broadway Club in Joplin, MO
description: DMD4 is a night of live music by Dance Monkey Dance, who play Ozark-bred Americana, psychedelic grooves, and rowdy roots music with banjo, bass, trombone, piano, and more. You can grab a drink and bring your dancing shoes. It takes place at the Old Broadway Club, 125 S Mineral Ave in Joplin, MO, on November 25, 2026, with the time to be determined.
address: 125 S Mineral Ave, Joplin, MO 64801, United States, Joplin, MO
